uplink.VALIDITY: THE COLUMN EXISTS BUT IS NOT AN UPLINK CAPACITY MEASURE. Every subset of this dataset (Download, Netflix, Amazon_Prime) is a DOWNLOAD workload, so UL_bitrate is the ACK and control traffic of a downloading app, not an uplink-saturating transfer. DL_bitrate is near capacity because the app saturates the downlink; UL_bitrate is not, and must NOT be used as a per-device uplink for Tier 1.
uplink.register_validity: CONSTRUCTED judgement about an OBSERVED column
